Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files using legitimate GnuPG (gpg.exe) encryption program
Kills processes (sql, chrome.exe, ie.exe, firefox.exe, opera.exe, safari.exe, taskmgr.exe, 1c)
Deletes shadow copies and backups (vssadmin.exe, wmic shadowcopy delete, wbadmin.exe delete catalog)
Modifies boot configuration data to disable recovery and ignore failures (bcdedit.exe)
Encrypts files on all drives except those containing specific excluded strings
Creates ransom note README_DECRYPT.txt with contact email
Attack Vector: Manual installation by attacker after hacking into Remote Desktop Services
